description: Test current iPhone and Android sizes, Safari and Chrome, portrait/landscape, forms, chat, videos, downloads, and checkout.

matrix.chrome: Google Chrome stable via Playwright channel=chrome (Blink). Covers current Android Chrome and iOS Chrome (CriOS user-agent + mobile viewport).
matrix.safari: Native Safari on iOS/macOS is not available on this Linux runner. Playwright WebKit 26.5 is the documented Safari / iOS Safari engine equivalent, with iOS 18 Safari user-agent.
matrix.edge: Not in scope for this row. Blink-equivalent to Chrome.

origins.canonicalApex: https://thebackhalf.org (ENOTFOUND from this environment; DNS not changed)
origins.canonicalWww: https://www.thebackhalf.org (ENOTFOUND from this environment; DNS not changed)

consoleErrors: webkit/iphone-se-landscape pageerror /website-two-psi-49.vercel.app/contact?_rsc=tXyZJ52UQVBCVsD3 due to access control checks.

tested: Public /lumina opening and main content on iPhone 16 Pro and Pixel 9, both orientations, Chrome and WebKit
notExecuted: Logged-in Lumina composer send on production participant account
Full in-player playback of every chapter video on a signed-in Architect

tested: Personalized guidebook API returns 401 without session
Architect Resources route redirects to login
Catalog shows Blueprint, Founding Architect, and Community offers

findings.detail: thebackhalf.org and www.thebackhalf.org did not resolve from this Cloud Agent network (ENOTFOUND). Same pre-existing gap recorded on al-178/al-184. DNS was not changed.
Authenticated Lumina composer was not live-sent. Production participant accounts were not used. Login gate to /architect/lumina was verified.
Live Stripe Checkout was not executed. Stripe configuration was not modified.
Native Safari on iOS/macOS was not available. Playwright WebKit 26.5 with iOS 18 Safari UA is the documented engine equivalent.

One WebKit pageerror on /contact RSC fetch (access control checks) during iPhone SE landscape layout sweep. Page still loaded. Same class of WebKit RSC noise recorded on al-184. Not treated as launch-blocking.

gaps: Canonical domain DNS from this Cloud Agent network
Native Chrome on iOS (CriOS) — UA emulated on Blink
Personalized download generation for a signed-in Architect
nextAction: Row 187 (Fix Responsive and Touch Issues) may proceed with remaining tap-target/keyboard polish. This matrix found no launch-blocking overflow, form, chat-gate, video HTTP, download, or checkout-catalog failures. Founder acceptance stays with Kimberly Walker (human).

test.nearest: none committed; one-off Playwright runner lived at /tmp/al-186-mobile-test.mjs

build.reason: status-only ops file; cannot affect production

npm test or the nearest package test script if present
npm run build if the change can affect production
